Great food, wine, and service
Dec 2017 • Couples
My husband and I were exploring the French Quarter and wanted something different than what we'd been eating for the past week. I found the reviews on Tripadvisor for this wine bar and we sought it out. It's a little hard to find but very much worth it. We ended up going for lunch and then dinner the next day. 

For lunch, we were seated upstairs. We ordered the special of meat and cheese board plus a bottle of wine for 500,000 VND. The server was very friendly and spoke English. The meat and cheese board was big enough to split between the two of us although we did end up ordering extra bread. The whole experience was lovely and we booked for the next night--our last night in Vietnam. 

My husband had found a wine the day before that he had wanted to try. When we arrived, it was on our table already. He asked for a slight chill on it and then they decanted it. I ordered the duck breast and he ordered the New Zealand steak. We also split smoked salmon canapés. All of the food was delicious and cooked perfectly. The duck breast was a large portion and the mashed potatoes were perfect. The only slight quibble was that my husband's french fries were a little cold. As the day before, the service was impeccable. They even sent us home with a bottle of wine. 

We really loved this place. A great change of pace in Hanoi.
